everyone.title: A new look
everyone.text: A new logo, font and dark theme, with clearer colours and plainer words.

everyone.title: The Android app
everyone.text: Agents send notifications and alarms straight to your phone, and can see where you are when you allow it. It comes to Google Play after this release.

everyone.title: Choose where a chat runs
everyone.text: A new remote machines icon on the chat page shows where the chat runs. Tap it to pick or change the place.

everyone.title: Auto, the default mode
everyone.text: Auto is now the default permission mode for every chat.

admins.title: An admin command line
admins.text: Admins can run the otodock-admin.sh script to reset a password, turn off a lost authenticator or print support information.

admins.title: Report a reply
admins.text: People can flag an agent's reply. You read the reports under Admin, Reports.

admins.title: GitHub through a GitHub App
admins.text: GitHub now signs in through a GitHub App, OtoDock's hosted one by default. An admin can add their own under Admin, MCP Servers.

everyone.title: Transfer a call to a colleague
everyone.text: The agent can hand a caller over to a colleague on the route's list.

everyone.title: Automatic language detection
everyone.text: Calls and dictation find the language from the first words and answer in it.

everyone.title: Upload a whole folder
everyone.text: Drop a folder into the chat or the workspace. Every file in it uploads.

everyone.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
everyone.text: The fastest Claude model, now on Claude Code and Direct LLM.

everyone.title: Call you from the chat
everyone.text: An agent that finds something in your chat can call you about it, knowing everything in that chat.

admins.title: Back up and restore by script
admins.text: One script backs up the whole install. Another one restores it.

admins.title: See the version and new releases
admins.text: Setup shows the running version and tells you when a new release is out.

admins.title: Ask for a PIN on outbound calls
admins.text: A route can ask the person who answers for a PIN before the agent speaks.
